sources.notes: Organiser spectator-zone pages embed GPS Visualizer HTML maps (one per stage road) containing the stage as a vector track plus 'SSS' (start) and 'SSF' (finish) markers; the page legend defines SSS/SSF as start/finish of the special stage. Start/finish taken from those markers. 12 of 14 distinct stage roads covered (21 of 23 SS). MISSING: SS3 Figueira da Foz (SSS, 1.93 km, tarmac) and SS19 Lousada (SSS, 3.78 km, at Eurocircuito da Costilha) - no spectator map, no coordinates on the municipality pages; road books (VRP2026_RB1-4.pdf) and Rally Guide 2 PDFs are password-protected; Rally_Maps PDF is raster. kind set to 'points' because ACP terms prohibit reproduction for non-personal purposes without written permission; vector tracks exist (routeRef kept). Lengths: SS1 Águeda / Sever: line 15.07 km vs official 15.08 (-0.0%); SS2 Sever / Albergaria: line 20.30 km vs official 20.24 (+0.3%) [track drawn finish->start]; SS4/10 Mortágua: line 14.73 km vs official 14.59 (+1.0%); SS5/7 Arganil: line 18.37 km vs official 18.62 (-1.3%) [track drawn finish->start]; SS6/9 Lousã: line 7.03 km vs official 7.07 (-0.5%) [track drawn finish->start]; SS8 Góis: line 15.33 km vs official 15.66 (-2.1%) [track drawn finish->start]; SS11/15 Felgueiras: line 8.96 km vs official 8.81 (+1.7%); SS12/16 Cabeceiras de Basto: line 20.08 km vs official 19.91 (+0.8%); SS13/17 Amarante: line 26.00 km vs official 26.24 (-0.9%); SS14/18 Paredes: line 16.04 km vs official 16.09 (-0.3%); SS20/22 Vieira do Minho: line 21.41 km vs official 21.60 (-0.9%); SS21/23 Fafe: line 11.08 km vs official 11.18 (-0.9%). Shakedown map 'SHAKEDOWN' track 5.55 km vs official 5.72; NOTE its SSS/SSF markers and track ends are identical to the Paredes map (Baltar shakedown shares start/finish area with Paredes stage) - treat shakedown geometry with caution. Matching by map title (e.g. 'SS21-23 FAFE') - unambiguous.
